section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces gratitude as a foundational aspect of well-being, consistently linked to better psychological, relational, and physical health. The current study aims to investigate the causal mechanisms of this gratitude-health relationship, specifically examining whether perceptions of loneliness and stress mediate the link between gratitude and physical health, drawing on the broaden and build theory and the find-remind-and-bind theory of gratitude.
